svg.title: Terminals for the AERI subtask loop: four for the robot stack, terminal D for the run
svg.desc: Earlier versions ran on the robot only in external mode, with an agent answering for the vision model; this version and the local vision model have not run on the robot. You start four robot-stack terminals as before: A arm stack, B gripper, C robot server, M health monitor. Terminal D runs aeri.py execute in seven numbered steps: check GPU, memory and ports; start the local vision model and put it to sleep; start the policy service; list the objects for you to confirm; run the rounds with one release per round; stop both and check they are gone. A failed step stops only what this run started.
